The complete log is the repository file <a href="https://github.com/mpmdw/JouleWise/blob/main/docs/decision_log.md"><code>docs/decision_log.md</code></a>.</p> </blockquote> <span id="d-073"></span><h2 id="d-073-d-016-device-list-amendment-mac-3080-ti-primary-fleet-12-gib-cap">D-073: D-016 device-list amendment — Mac + 3080 Ti primary fleet, 12 GiB cap</h2> <p>Date: 2026-07-16. Owner: Ed (ruled on the D-071 brief, <code>docs/process_traces/2026-07-16-device-list-brief/brief.md</code>). The primary cross-target fleet is the 128 GB M3 Max Mac and the 3080 Ti (12 GiB) rig; the G10 capacity cap re-floors from 8 GiB to <strong>12 GiB</strong> (3080 Ti class sets the floor). Jetson hardware is retained as OPTIONAL, non-cap-setting replication — the edge/8 GiB cell can be added later as a replication row without re-deciding this. The split study&#39;s two nodes are the Mac and the 3080 Ti rig. Big models remain open via the Mac-only subsystem (D-071 clause 3). Follow-ons ruled by Ed same session: (a) conditional primary-model repin remains open with a WIDENED candidate search under the new cap (Ed: &quot;is there really nothing better than Qwen3-1.7B? Gemma 4B or something?&quot;) — 3-4B-class models now fit comfortably; (b) dense/MoE pair re-search under the 12 GiB cap (OLMo dense arm failed G4 as published — see the OLMo verification record in the same trace directory).</p> <span id="d-074"></span><h2 id="d-074-conditional-qwen3-4b-primary-repin-olmo-1b-conversion-spike-authorized">D-074: Conditional Qwen3-4B primary repin + OLMo-1B conversion spike authorized</h2> <p>Date: 2026-07-16. Owner: Ed (ruled on the 12 GiB model search, <code>docs/process_traces/2026-07-16-device-list-brief/model-search-12gib.md</code>). (1) Qwen3-4B becomes the D-016 primary CONDITIONALLY: the repin lands only when the evidence gates pass (immutable source/license, MLX-Q4/GGUF-Q4/CUDA artifact receipts, three-runtime generation, G10 at the 12 GiB cap, KV receipts, thinking-mode policy pinned); any gate failure retains Qwen2.5-1.5B. New evidence era on success: manifests + quant ladder regenerate from one frozen source revision; Qwen2.5 results preserved as legacy. Runner-up Qwen3-1.7B; Gemma-3-4B rejected for the gated custom license + multimodal MLX seam. (2) The time-boxed OLMo-1B original-format→MLX conversion spike is authorized; success revives the matched OLMoE pair, failure files the dated negative finding and the pair defers (Option C) without re-litigation. Both execute next session as agent-lane work.</p> <span id="d-075"></span><h2 id="d-075-extension-axis-intake-ranked-fold-in-without-new-thesis-proliferation">D-075: Extension-axis intake — ranked fold-in without new thesis proliferation</h2> <ul> <li>Date: 2026-07-17</li> <li>Status: accepted (Ed-directed intake via the 2026-07-17 evaluation)</li> <li>Phase: Phase 2+ research program</li> </ul> <p>Context: Ed directed a six-axis evaluation and ratified the resulting roadmap at <code>docs/process_traces/2026-07-17-extension-axes/roadmap-synthesis.md</code>. D-055 keeps C5 deliberation in the bank and the registry as the canonical live index; D-070 keeps these axes as stress tests of Q4, caps candidate commitments at L2, and reserves commitment authority to Ed. The disposition ledger is <code>docs/stream_logs/2026-07-17-axes-foldin.md</code>.</p> <p>Decision:</p> <ol> <li>Admit C5-2.5c as the primary speculative-decoding Q4 break-even rider, C5-2.5b as its proposal-work secondary, and C5-2.5d as a mandatory contamination control. Preserve C5-2.5a in the deliberative bank as a deferred candidate rider only; it is not a standalone campaign commitment before a prospective cross-mechanism design is affordable. All four retain the evaluation&#39;s exact ceilings and forbidden upgrades, and C-023-OUTPUT-IDENTITY is binding.</li> <li>Admit C5-2.11 as the on-device MLX quantized-KV candidate and attach it to C5-2.4, C5-1.12, and C-023-QUALITY-EQUIV-QUANT. Preserve C5-2.12, C5-2.13, and C5-2.14 only as candidate riders on the existing context/KV-growth, prompt-cache/replay, and Q4/AP-1 homes.</li> <li>Admit one new canonical RQ row, RQ-AXI-HYBRID-PAIR, at an L2 named-pair ceiling. Attach the attention/context-slope and module-attribution refinements to existing rows. Record kernel/backend provenance as amendments to C5-1.8, C5-2.7, and C5-3.3, not new theses.</li> <li>Keep the roadmap&#39;s do-not-fold set out of the canonical row set. Its negative dispositions and all unresolved feasibility questions remain in the stream ledger, including explicit <strong>NEEDS-WEB</strong> markers. Intake does not convert an unresolved runtime, model-pair, adapter, or device-fit question into a capstone commitment.</li> </ol> <p>Options considered:</p> <ol> <li>Mint every evaluated suggestion as an independent live question. Rejected: it duplicates existing homes, imports unidentifiable mechanism claims, and violates D-070&#39;s single-Q4-thesis posture.</li> <li>Admit only the top three ranked items. Rejected: the lower-cost controls, riders, and provenance amendments prevent predictable attribution errors without creating independent theses.</li> <li>Apply the roadmap&#39;s ranked fold-in and explicit exclusions. Chosen by Ed.</li> </ol> <p>Considerations: this is research-agenda intake, not campaign scheduling or evidence promotion. Every admitted candidate/rider remains floor-gated, earliest-phase tagged, capped at L2 unless an already-existing parent row&#39;s separate machinery says otherwise, and subject to its named forbidden upgrade. The published corpus remains claim-evidence-flagged; no fixture, runtime feasibility result, or registry entry is live energy evidence. D-070 remains the authority for Ed&#39;s axis commitments and quiet-Mac ordering.</p> <p>Revisit triggers: a relevant <strong>NEEDS-WEB</strong> feasibility finding lands; a named runtime/pair becomes unsupported; P2-015 floors make a predeclared effect undetectable; or Ed changes the D-070 commitment set. Revisit by amending the owning row and this decision&#39;s ledger, never by silently promoting an excluded candidate.</p> <span id="d-076"></span><h2 id="d-076-site-capacity-right-sizing-aud-wo-039-review-measured-first-budgets">D-076: Site capacity right-sizing (AUD-WO-039 review) — measured-first budgets</h2> <p>Date: 2026-07-17/18. Owner: lead under Ed&#39;s &quot;host the brief&quot; directive (the capacity decision event AUD-WO-039 fenced on). Ruling, encoded in tests with PR #76: the 1 MiB Lakebed hard cap is inviolate; the measured-artifact budget is 1,000,000 B (measured mode via the pinned validator, SITE-02 loud-discovery discipline); the 943,718 B conservative-estimate guard remains ONLY as fallback when measured mode is unavailable (estimator overshoot documented ~4.3% on identical input). WO-039 preservation boundary held: no advisor-facing page, navigation, provenance, or deep link trimmed. Current measured artifact 961,210 B. Revisit trigger: measured artifact within 24 KB of the hard cap forces the next right-sizing review before any addition.</p> <span id="d-077"></span><h2 id="d-077-environment-guard-idle-admission-and-cooldown-v2">D-077: Environment guard, idle admission, and cooldown v2</h2> <ul> <li>Date: 2026-07-17</li> <li>Status: accepted</li> <li>Phase: 2 / measurement</li> </ul> <p>Context: a Ventura video screensaver compositing on an awake display was identified as a material, repeatable contaminant. The affected windows showed about 50% GPU duty and were already detected by the existing <code>idle_window_suspect</code> thresholds. The campaign preflight, per-run admission, and D-014 cooldown nevertheless lacked one shared environment policy, exact override custody, and a sustained-window implementation. In particular, the old cooldown could release after one 5-second sub-window even though the contract called for a rolling 30-second recovery window.</p> <p>Options considered:</p> <ol> <li>Treat doctor output as a quietness certificate and continue to rely on operator judgment between members. Rejected: a point-in-time advisory cannot certify the later measured window and cannot enforce fixed-n admission.</li> <li>Change persistent display/screensaver preferences or allow contaminated members to be skipped or waived. Rejected: campaign preparation must not mutate host policy, and outcome-dependent skipping/waiving would break the fixed-n design and conceal the contamination.</li> <li>Use a hash-bound campaign-policy sidecar, an enforcing campaign preflight, per-run idle admission with one evidence-bearing retry, and cooldown v2 with frozen clean-anchor fallback. Chosen.</li> </ol> <p>Decision:</p> <ul> <li>A shared pure evaluator owns environment findings. Doctor consumes it only advisorily. <code>run_campaign.py</code> consumes it enforcingly after taking the campaign lock and before member 1. Critical unknowns fail closed. Load average is recorded as evidence but is never a member-admission gate.</li> <li>The production quiet-Mac policy requires AC power with an externally connected source, low-power mode off, all online displays asleep, the screensaver disengaged, and Nominal thermal pressure. Quiet-mode arming is explicit and transient: countdown, <code>pmset displaysleepnow</code>, then a complete re-probe. Persistent settings are never changed.</li> <li>An environment override must name the exact snapshot and findings digests it acknowledges. It is recorded as an override, never a waiver, and makes every resulting member universally claim-ineligible.</li> <li>Per-run idle admission reuses the validated <code>idle_window_suspect == false</code> threshold. It permits exactly one fully evidenced retry with distinct raw artifacts. Persistent awake-display, screensaver, or unknown critical state aborts immediately. Production aborts after retry; the exploratory-only <code>flag</code> path completes the fixed-n member but stamps the unwaivable <code>environment_admission_failed</code> reason on gross-energy, idle-subtracted-energy, and throughput claims. There is no skip action.</li> <li>Cooldown v2 amends D-014: recovery requires a complete, duration-weighted, sustained 30-second evidence window; the one-sided rule is <code>rolling_mean &lt;= reference * (1 + tolerance)</code>, so a below-reference window is recovered. Nominal thermal state is conjunctive. A calibrated absolute ceiling, when configured, is only an additional upper cap. A preceding baseline is reference-eligible only when its idle window is clean, critical environment checks passed, and policy/environment provenance is present. Otherwise the campaign uses one frozen clean anchor (NEG-8 reference start when present, else the first admission-passing baseline), records its provenance, never updates it from later outcomes, and fails closed when no eligible reference or anchor exists. Historical recovered rows are not reinterpreted.</li> <li>The policy owner is a strictly typed, byte-hashed sidecar under <code>configs/campaign_policies/</code>; policy version and SHA-256 are copied into each governed bundle. Campaign execution defaults to the production sidecar. Direct <code>joulewise run</code> without a sidecar retains legacy non-enforcing behavior. All bundle/config additions are nullable or omission-serialized; legacy normalized config bytes and hashes are unchanged.</li> <li>This amends D-057&#39;s stable claim-reason vocabulary by adding <code>environment_admission_failed</code> and <code>environment_override</code>. Both are universal and unwaivable for gross-energy, idle-subtracted-energy, and throughput claims.</li> </ul> <p>Considerations: environment admission is measurement-apparatus integrity, not post-hoc data cleaning. Duration weighting prevents irregular sub-window cadence from manufacturing coverage. Frozen-anchor provenance prevents a contaminated or outcome-selected member from quietly becoming the campaign&#39;s new recovery reference. The doctor remains useful as an early advisor without claiming more than its snapshot can prove.</p> <p>Consequences: campaign and bundle contracts gain policy/preflight/admission provenance, environment snapshots gain nullable display/screensaver/HID fields plus a post-run observation, and D-014&#39;s recovery wording is governed by cooldown v2 for new evidence. This decision is separate from AUD-WO-033, which remains behavior-preserving; D-077 intentionally changes future measurement admission and cooldown behavior and does not reinterpret sealed historical bundles.</p> <p>Revisit when: live quiet-window validation contradicts the defensive <code>pmset -g systemstate</code> display parser; calibrated platform data justifies an absolute ceiling; or a new platform cannot expose an equivalent critical probe without privilege.</p> <p>Fix-round amendment (2026-07-18): review found that summing sub-window durations as the completeness test made small inter-probe gaps reject an otherwise complete wall-clock window. Cooldown v2 now requires both a retained wall-clock span of at least <code>sustained_window_s</code> and captured coverage of at least <code>coverage_fraction * sustained_window_s</code>, with <code>coverage_fraction</code> defaulting to 0.8 and recorded in thresholds, trace rows, and release evidence. The same fix round made the existing frozen-reference rule operational for controller repetitions, attached cooldown evidence to each physical repetition (and each AXI entry), froze the first eligible repetition in execution order, re-probed the full governed environment per repetition, and added a guard observation after every idle capture. Environment-preflight early exits now retain a terminal campaign verdict; missing screensaver defaults domains use the macOS 20-minute default; and the two D-077 claim barriers are registered in the canonical reducer vocabulary. These are defect corrections to the accepted policy, not new policy alternatives.</p> <nav class="doc-meta" aria-label="Decision log parts"><span>Decision log parts:</span> <a href="decision_log.html">Recent</a> · <strong aria-current="page">Archive 1</strong></nav> </div> </div> </main> <footer class="site"> <div class="inner"> <span>JouleWise · github.com/mpmdw/JouleWise</span> <span>docs/decision_log.md · commit 1af9f92 + uncommitted · regenerate: <span class="mono">python3 scripts/build_site.py</span></span> </div> </footer> </body> </html>

Log</h1> <p>This is the canonical record of design decisions for JouleWise. Every decision that binds later work, trades off real alternatives, or would otherwise need to be re-derived by a future agent gets an entry here.</p> <h2 id="how-to-use-this-log">How To Use This Log</h2> <ul> <li>Before implementing anything non-trivial, check whether a decision here already covers it. Do not silently re-decide settled questions.</li> <li>When you make a new decision of this kind during a run, add an entry, link it from the run report, and reference its ID (<code>D-NNN</code>) in the code review or doc that applies it.</li> <li>Statuses: <code>accepted</code> (binding until revisited), <code>open</code> (criteria defined, evidence pending), <code>proposed</code> (recorded, awaiting Ed&#39;s ratification), <code>superseded by D-NNN</code>.</li> <li>Every entry must include Options Considered and Considerations. A decision without recorded alternatives is not auditable.</li> <li>Revisit triggers are part of the contract: when a trigger fires, the decision must be re-examined, not quietly worked around.</li> </ul> <h2 id="index">Index</h2> <div class="table-scroll"><table> <thead> <tr> <th>ID</th> <th>Title</th> <th>Status</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>D-001</td> <td>Run bundles store normalized <code>config.json</code>, not YAML</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-002</td> <td>Telemetry sampling via subprocess + file, no controller threading</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-003</td> <td>Timestamp and clock-alignment policy</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-004</td> <td><code>powermetrics</code> privilege workflow</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-005</td> <td>One bundle per repetition, grouped by experiment manifest</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-006</td> <td>Dashboard v1 is a static HTML report generator</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-007</td> <td>YAML config input is deferred</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-008</td> <td>Split runs arrive via schema v0.2 (<code>run_kind</code> + <code>split_plan</code>)</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-009</td> <td>Dependency policy: stdlib core, optional extras</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-010</td> <td>Run ID scheme</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-011</td> <td><code>summary_metrics.json</code> is the bundle completion marker</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-012</td> <td>Failure-reason to run-status mapping</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-013</td> <td>Controller-as-DUT mitigation for Mac-local runs</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-014</td> <td>Statistical protocol for repeated runs</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-015</td> <td>Split-mechanism priority and same-runtime rule</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-016</td> <td>Benchmark model selection</td> <td>open (provisional small-model pick 2026-07-06; opens 2G only)</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-017</td> <td>CI scope</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-018</td> <td>Per-backend <code>power_w</code> definition and rail policy</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-019</td> <td>Mock adapters use simulated time via an injectable clock</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-020</td> <td>CLI binds <code>FakeClock</code> for all-mock runs, <code>SystemClock</code> otherwise</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-021</td> <td>Controller flushes <code>events.jsonl</code> before the reduce stage</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-022</td> <td>Auto-generated run-ID suffix is config-hash-derived, not random</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-023</td> <td>Per-item phase status lives solely in the exit checklists</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-024</td> <td>Adapters receive a <code>RunContext</code>, not piecemeal parameters</td> <td>accepted; implemented (2N.1, 2026-07-06)</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-025</td> <td>One shared bundle read layer for reducer, report, validation, and aggregation</td> <td>accepted; implemented (2N.8, 2026-07-06)</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-026</td> <td>Measured window is bounded by sampling-active marker events</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-027</td> <td>Per-rail rows must share per-sample timestamps; misalignment is a structured failure</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-028</td> <td><code>reduce</code> verb rewrites <code>summary_metrics.json</code> in place (the one sanctioned post-finalize mutation)</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-029</td> <td>Config schema declares nullable optionals; interop lane remains post-2M + post-P2-010a</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-042</td> <td>D-034 implementation lane reopened; suite build may proceed pre-2M</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-043</td> <td>Supersession-closure discipline</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-044</td> <td>Suite config identity: omission-serialized ref + effective-manifest hash</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-045</td> <td>Suite substrate execution semantics (run_suite, statuses, per-item outputs)</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-046</td> <td>AP-6 sentinel delivery is ids-native BOS-less at literal equal shape</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-047</td> <td>Affine ladder pins: level set, smoke sizing, gate denominators</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-048</td> <td>Split program is model-first: pre-registered compositional prediction before split runs</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-049</td> <td>Split transfer-energy boundary accounting on discrete-GPU ends</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-050</td> <td>Active stop cards and process-trace manifests</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-051</td> <td>Advisor status site uses source-derived static pages plus fail-soft live GitHub overlays</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-052</td> <td>Capstone scope contract: frozen umbrella headline and contribution ladder</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-053</td> <td>Contrast-level statistical inference and the frozen analysis registry</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-054</td> <td>False-effect guard floor and unknown-term claim-ceiling policy</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-055</td> <td>Research-question registry is the canonical live index</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-056</td> <td>Suite order policies and order_row provenance</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-057</td> <td>Uncertainty terms: drift is a bound; stable claim-gate reason codes</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-058</td> <td>Token-normalization and stack-identity contract adopted</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-059</td> <td>Claims-lint mechanical enforcement in CI</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-060</td> <td>Depth-before-breadth stop line</td> <td>accepted (ratified 2026-07-10)</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-061</td> <td>Review-layer evaluation rule v2</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-062</td> <td>Confirmatory sampling policy (fixed n, demotion)</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-063</td> <td>Process architecture v2 (state kernel first)</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-064</td> <td>Delegated-invocation compliance surface: tracked per-session JSONL event stream, canonical report envelope, enforced write scope</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-065</td> <td>bridge-protocol/v1.1 — co-work lane, session wrappers, tolerant envelope</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-066</td> <td>Scoped spec-freeze override for the AXI extension agenda (Ed override)</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-067</td> <td>Idle reporting basis — gross headline; idle-subtracted is a labeled within-device secondary view</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-068</td> <td>Site deployment is Ed-manual; sessions end with a drift report, never a deploy</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-069</td> <td>Advisor-doc alignment (stream S-0) is sanctioned front-facing work</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-070</td> <td>Architectural-axes extension agenda (AXI): scope, claim posture, batch-axis rulings</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-071</td> <td>G10 memory-fit rule ratified (axi-sd-memory-fit-shape-v1); device-list review opened</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-072</td> <td>Standing self-merge-with-full-gate authority (gh merges included)</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td><a href="decision_log_archive_1.html#d-073">D-073</a></td> <td>D-016 device-list amendment: Mac + 3080 Ti primary fleet, 12 GiB cap</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td><a href="decision_log_archive_1.html#d-074">D-074</a></td> <td>Conditional Qwen3-4B primary repin + OLMo-1B conversion spike authorized</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td><a href="decision_log_archive_1.html#d-075">D-075</a></td> <td>Extension-axis intake: ranked fold-in without new thesis proliferation</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td><a href="decision_log_archive_1.html#d-076">D-076</a></td> <td>Site capacity right-sizing (AUD-WO-039 review): measured-first budgets</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td><a href="decision_log_archive_1.html#d-077">D-077</a></td> <td>Environment guard, idle admission, and cooldown v2</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td><a href="decision_log.html#d-078">D-078</a></td> <td>Soundness gate: no claim-bearing extraction from time-anchor-defective powermetrics corpora</td> <td>accepted; operative under Ed&#39;s direction through the full repair arc (close-out cap explicitly Ed-ratified 2026-07-22; original-text ratification rides PR #79 review)</td> </tr> </tbody></table></div> <hr> <blockquote> <p><strong>Site view:</strong> the complete entry index appears above; the 72 older full entries are omitted from this page for capsule size. The complete log is the repository file <a href="https://github.com/mpmdw/JouleWise/blob/main/docs/decision_log.md"><code>docs/decision_log.md</code></a>.</p> </blockquote> <span id="d-073"></span><h2 id="d-073-d-016-device-list-amendment-mac-3080-ti-primary-fleet-12-gib-cap">D-073: D-016 device-list amendment — Mac + 3080 Ti primary fleet, 12 GiB cap</h2> <p>Date: 2026-07-16. Owner: Ed (ruled on the D-071 brief, <code>docs/process_traces/2026-07-16-device-list-brief/brief.md</code>). The primary cross-target fleet is the 128 GB M3 Max Mac and the 3080 Ti (12 GiB) rig; the G10 capacity cap re-floors from 8 GiB to <strong>12 GiB</strong> (3080 Ti class sets the floor). Jetson hardware is retained as OPTIONAL, non-cap-setting replication — the edge/8 GiB cell can be added later as a replication row without re-deciding this. The split study&#39;s two nodes are the Mac and the 3080 Ti rig. Big models remain open via the Mac-only subsystem (D-071 clause 3). Follow-ons ruled by Ed same session: (a) conditional primary-model repin remains open with a WIDENED candidate search under the new cap (Ed: &quot;is there really nothing better than Qwen3-1.7B? Gemma 4B or something?&quot;) — 3-4B-class models now fit comfortably; (b) dense/MoE pair re-search under the 12 GiB cap (OLMo dense arm failed G4 as published — see the OLMo verification record in the same trace directory).</p> <span id="d-074"></span><h2 id="d-074-conditional-qwen3-4b-primary-repin-olmo-1b-conversion-spike-authorized">D-074: Conditional Qwen3-4B primary repin + OLMo-1B conversion spike authorized</h2> <p>Date: 2026-07-16. Owner: Ed (ruled on the 12 GiB model search, <code>docs/process_traces/2026-07-16-device-list-brief/model-search-12gib.md</code>). (1) Qwen3-4B becomes the D-016 primary CONDITIONALLY: the repin lands only when the evidence gates pass (immutable source/license, MLX-Q4/GGUF-Q4/CUDA artifact receipts, three-runtime generation, G10 at the 12 GiB cap, KV receipts, thinking-mode policy pinned); any gate failure retains Qwen2.5-1.5B. New evidence era on success: manifests + quant ladder regenerate from one frozen source revision; Qwen2.5 results preserved as legacy. Runner-up Qwen3-1.7B; Gemma-3-4B rejected for the gated custom license + multimodal MLX seam. (2) The time-boxed OLMo-1B original-format→MLX conversion spike is authorized; success revives the matched OLMoE pair, failure files the dated negative finding and the pair defers (Option C) without re-litigation. Both execute next session as agent-lane work.</p> <span id="d-075"></span><h2 id="d-075-extension-axis-intake-ranked-fold-in-without-new-thesis-proliferation">D-075: Extension-axis intake — ranked fold-in without new thesis proliferation</h2> <ul> <li>Date: 2026-07-17</li> <li>Status: accepted (Ed-directed intake via the 2026-07-17 evaluation)</li> <li>Phase: Phase 2+ research program</li> </ul> <p>Context: Ed directed a six-axis evaluation and ratified the resulting roadmap at <code>docs/process_traces/2026-07-17-extension-axes/roadmap-synthesis.md</code>. D-055 keeps C5 deliberation in the bank and the registry as the canonical live index; D-070 keeps these axes as stress tests of Q4, caps candidate commitments at L2, and reserves commitment authority to Ed. The disposition ledger is <code>docs/stream_logs/2026-07-17-axes-foldin.md</code>.</p> <p>Decision:</p> <ol> <li>Admit C5-2.5c as the primary speculative-decoding Q4 break-even rider, C5-2.5b as its proposal-work secondary, and C5-2.5d as a mandatory contamination control. Preserve C5-2.5a in the deliberative bank as a deferred candidate rider only; it is not a standalone campaign commitment before a prospective cross-mechanism design is affordable. All four retain the evaluation&#39;s exact ceilings and forbidden upgrades, and C-023-OUTPUT-IDENTITY is binding.</li> <li>Admit C5-2.11 as the on-device MLX quantized-KV candidate and attach it to C5-2.4, C5-1.12, and C-023-QUALITY-EQUIV-QUANT. Preserve C5-2.12, C5-2.13, and C5-2.14 only as candidate riders on the existing context/KV-growth, prompt-cache/replay, and Q4/AP-1 homes.</li> <li>Admit one new canonical RQ row, RQ-AXI-HYBRID-PAIR, at an L2 named-pair ceiling. Attach the attention/context-slope and module-attribution refinements to existing rows. Record kernel/backend provenance as amendments to C5-1.8, C5-2.7, and C5-3.3, not new theses.</li> <li>Keep the roadmap&#39;s do-not-fold set out of the canonical row set. Its negative dispositions and all unresolved feasibility questions remain in the stream ledger, including explicit <strong>NEEDS-WEB</strong> markers. Intake does not convert an unresolved runtime, model-pair, adapter, or device-fit question into a capstone commitment.</li> </ol> <p>Options considered:</p> <ol> <li>Mint every evaluated suggestion as an independent live question. Rejected: it duplicates existing homes, imports unidentifiable mechanism claims, and violates D-070&#39;s single-Q4-thesis posture.</li> <li>Admit only the top three ranked items. Rejected: the lower-cost controls, riders, and provenance amendments prevent predictable attribution errors without creating independent theses.</li> <li>Apply the roadmap&#39;s ranked fold-in and explicit exclusions. Chosen by Ed.</li> </ol> <p>Considerations: this is research-agenda intake, not campaign scheduling or evidence promotion. Every admitted candidate/rider remains floor-gated, earliest-phase tagged, capped at L2 unless an already-existing parent row&#39;s separate machinery says otherwise, and subject to its named forbidden upgrade. The published corpus remains claim-evidence-flagged; no fixture, runtime feasibility result, or registry entry is live energy evidence. D-070 remains the authority for Ed&#39;s axis commitments and quiet-Mac ordering.</p> <p>Revisit triggers: a relevant <strong>NEEDS-WEB</strong> feasibility finding lands; a named runtime/pair becomes unsupported; P2-015 floors make a predeclared effect undetectable; or Ed changes the D-070 commitment set. Revisit by amending the owning row and this decision&#39;s ledger, never by silently promoting an excluded candidate.</p> <span id="d-076"></span><h2 id="d-076-site-capacity-right-sizing-aud-wo-039-review-measured-first-budgets">D-076: Site capacity right-sizing (AUD-WO-039 review) — measured-first budgets</h2> <p>Date: 2026-07-17/18. Owner: lead under Ed&#39;s &quot;host the brief&quot; directive (the capacity decision event AUD-WO-039 fenced on). Ruling, encoded in tests with PR #76: the 1 MiB Lakebed hard cap is inviolate; the measured-artifact budget is 1,000,000 B (measured mode via the pinned validator, SITE-02 loud-discovery discipline); the 943,718 B conservative-estimate guard remains ONLY as fallback when measured mode is unavailable (estimator overshoot documented ~4.3% on identical input). WO-039 preservation boundary held: no advisor-facing page, navigation, provenance, or deep link trimmed. Current measured artifact 961,210 B. Revisit trigger: measured artifact within 24 KB of the hard cap forces the next right-sizing review before any addition.</p> <span id="d-077"></span><h2 id="d-077-environment-guard-idle-admission-and-cooldown-v2">D-077: Environment guard, idle admission, and cooldown v2</h2> <ul> <li>Date: 2026-07-17</li> <li>Status: accepted</li> <li>Phase: 2 / measurement</li> </ul> <p>Context: a Ventura video screensaver compositing on an awake display was identified as a material, repeatable contaminant. The affected windows showed about 50% GPU duty and were already detected by the existing <code>idle_window_suspect</code> thresholds. The campaign preflight, per-run admission, and D-014 cooldown nevertheless lacked one shared environment policy, exact override custody, and a sustained-window implementation. In particular, the old cooldown could release after one 5-second sub-window even though the contract called for a rolling 30-second recovery window.</p> <p>Options considered:</p> <ol> <li>Treat doctor output as a quietness certificate and continue to rely on operator judgment between members. Rejected: a point-in-time advisory cannot certify the later measured window and cannot enforce fixed-n admission.</li> <li>Change persistent display/screensaver preferences or allow contaminated members to be skipped or waived. Rejected: campaign preparation must not mutate host policy, and outcome-dependent skipping/waiving would break the fixed-n design and conceal the contamination.</li> <li>Use a hash-bound campaign-policy sidecar, an enforcing campaign preflight, per-run idle admission with one evidence-bearing retry, and cooldown v2 with frozen clean-anchor fallback. Chosen.</li> </ol> <p>Decision:</p> <ul> <li>A shared pure evaluator owns environment findings. Doctor consumes it only advisorily. <code>run_campaign.py</code> consumes it enforcingly after taking the campaign lock and before member 1. Critical unknowns fail closed. Load average is recorded as evidence but is never a member-admission gate.</li> <li>The production quiet-Mac policy requires AC power with an externally connected source, low-power mode off, all online displays asleep, the screensaver disengaged, and Nominal thermal pressure. Quiet-mode arming is explicit and transient: countdown, <code>pmset displaysleepnow</code>, then a complete re-probe. Persistent settings are never changed.</li> <li>An environment override must name the exact snapshot and findings digests it acknowledges. It is recorded as an override, never a waiver, and makes every resulting member universally claim-ineligible.</li> <li>Per-run idle admission reuses the validated <code>idle_window_suspect == false</code> threshold. It permits exactly one fully evidenced retry with distinct raw artifacts. Persistent awake-display, screensaver, or unknown critical state aborts immediately. Production aborts after retry; the exploratory-only <code>flag</code> path completes the fixed-n member but stamps the unwaivable <code>environment_admission_failed</code> reason on gross-energy, idle-subtracted-energy, and throughput claims. There is no skip action.</li> <li>Cooldown v2 amends D-014: recovery requires a complete, duration-weighted, sustained 30-second evidence window; the one-sided rule is <code>rolling_mean &lt;= reference * (1 + tolerance)</code>, so a below-reference window is recovered. Nominal thermal state is conjunctive. A calibrated absolute ceiling, when configured, is only an additional upper cap. A preceding baseline is reference-eligible only when its idle window is clean, critical environment checks passed, and policy/environment provenance is present. Otherwise the campaign uses one frozen clean anchor (NEG-8 reference start when present, else the first admission-passing baseline), records its provenance, never updates it from later outcomes, and fails closed when no eligible reference or anchor exists. Historical recovered rows are not reinterpreted.</li> <li>The policy owner is a strictly typed, byte-hashed sidecar under <code>configs/campaign_policies/</code>; policy version and SHA-256 are copied into each governed bundle. Campaign execution defaults to the production sidecar. Direct <code>joulewise run</code> without a sidecar retains legacy non-enforcing behavior. All bundle/config additions are nullable or omission-serialized; legacy normalized config bytes and hashes are unchanged.</li> <li>This amends D-057&#39;s stable claim-reason vocabulary by adding <code>environment_admission_failed</code> and <code>environment_override</code>. Both are universal and unwaivable for gross-energy, idle-subtracted-energy, and throughput claims.</li> </ul> <p>Considerations: environment admission is measurement-apparatus integrity, not post-hoc data cleaning. Duration weighting prevents irregular sub-window cadence from manufacturing coverage. Frozen-anchor provenance prevents a contaminated or outcome-selected member from quietly becoming the campaign&#39;s new recovery reference. The doctor remains useful as an early advisor without claiming more than its snapshot can prove.</p> <p>Consequences: campaign and bundle contracts gain policy/preflight/admission provenance, environment snapshots gain nullable display/screensaver/HID fields plus a post-run observation, and D-014&#39;s recovery wording is governed by cooldown v2 for new evidence. This decision is separate from AUD-WO-033, which remains behavior-preserving; D-077 intentionally changes future measurement admission and cooldown behavior and does not reinterpret sealed historical bundles.</p> <p>Revisit when: live quiet-window validation contradicts the defensive <code>pmset -g systemstate</code> display parser; calibrated platform data justifies an absolute ceiling; or a new platform cannot expose an equivalent critical probe without privilege.</p> <p>Fix-round amendment (2026-07-18): review found that summing sub-window durations as the completeness test made small inter-probe gaps reject an otherwise complete wall-clock window. Cooldown v2 now requires both a retained wall-clock span of at least <code>sustained_window_s</code> and captured coverage of at least <code>coverage_fraction * sustained_window_s</code>, with <code>coverage_fraction</code> defaulting to 0.8 and recorded in thresholds, trace rows, and release evidence. The same fix round made the existing frozen-reference rule operational for controller repetitions, attached cooldown evidence to each physical repetition (and each AXI entry), froze the first eligible repetition in execution order, re-probed the full governed environment per repetition, and added a guard observation after every idle capture. Environment-preflight early exits now retain a terminal campaign verdict; missing screensaver defaults domains use the macOS 20-minute default; and the two D-077 claim barriers are registered in the canonical reducer vocabulary. These are defect corrections to the accepted policy, not new policy alternatives.</p> <nav class="doc-meta" aria-label="Decision log parts"><span>Decision log parts:</span> <a href="decision_log.html">Recent</a> · <strong aria-current="page">Archive 1</strong></nav> </div> </div> </main> <footer class="site"> <div class="inner"> <span>JouleWise · github.com/mpmdw/JouleWise</span> <span>docs/decision_log.md · commit 1af9f92 + uncommitted · regenerate: <span class="mono">python3 scripts/build_site.py</span></span> </div> </footer> </body> </html>

<a href="decision_log.html">Recent</a> · <strong aria-current="page">Archive 1</strong></nav> <div class="provenance-plate"><span class="source-chip" title="docs/decision_log.md · commit 1af9f92 + uncommitted"><span class="source-file">docs/<wbr>decision_log.md</span><span class="source-commit">commit 1af9f92 + uncommitted</span></span></div> <!-- rendered: marked@18.0.6 --> <h1>Decision Log</h1> <p>This is the canonical record of design decisions for JouleWise. Every decision that binds later work, trades off real alternatives, or would otherwise need to be re-derived by a future agent gets an entry here.</p> <h2 id="how-to-use-this-log">How To Use This Log</h2> <ul> <li>Before implementing anything non-trivial, check whether a decision here already covers it. Do not silently re-decide settled questions.</li> <li>When you make a new decision of this kind during a run, add an entry, link it from the run report, and reference its ID (<code>D-NNN</code>) in the code review or doc that applies it.</li> <li>Statuses: <code>accepted</code> (binding until revisited), <code>open</code> (criteria defined, evidence pending), <code>proposed</code> (recorded, awaiting Ed&#39;s ratification), <code>superseded by D-NNN</code>.</li> <li>Every entry must include Options Considered and Considerations. A decision without recorded alternatives is not auditable.</li> <li>Revisit triggers are part of the contract: when a trigger fires, the decision must be re-examined, not quietly worked around.</li> </ul> <h2 id="index">Index</h2> <div class="table-scroll"><table> <thead> <tr> <th>ID</th> <th>Title</th> <th>Status</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>D-001</td> <td>Run bundles store normalized <code>config.json</code>, not YAML</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-002</td> <td>Telemetry sampling via subprocess + file, no controller threading</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-003</td> <td>Timestamp and clock-alignment policy</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-004</td> <td><code>powermetrics</code> privilege workflow</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-005</td> <td>One bundle per repetition, grouped by experiment manifest</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-006</td> <td>Dashboard v1 is a static HTML report generator</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-007</td> <td>YAML config input is deferred</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-008</td> <td>Split runs arrive via schema v0.2 (<code>run_kind</code> + <code>split_plan</code>)</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-009</td> <td>Dependency policy: stdlib core, optional extras</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-010</td> <td>Run ID scheme</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-011</td> <td><code>summary_metrics.json</code> is the bundle completion marker</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-012</td> <td>Failure-reason to run-status mapping</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-013</td> <td>Controller-as-DUT mitigation for Mac-local runs</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-014</td> <td>Statistical protocol for repeated runs</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-015</td> <td>Split-mechanism priority and same-runtime rule</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-016</td> <td>Benchmark model selection</td> <td>open (provisional small-model pick 2026-07-06; opens 2G only)</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-017</td> <td>CI scope</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-018</td> <td>Per-backend <code>power_w</code> definition and rail policy</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-019</td> <td>Mock adapters use simulated time via an injectable clock</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-020</td> <td>CLI binds <code>FakeClock</code> for all-mock runs, <code>SystemClock</code> otherwise</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-021</td> <td>Controller flushes <code>events.jsonl</code> before the reduce stage</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-022</td> <td>Auto-generated run-ID suffix is config-hash-derived, not random</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-023</td> <td>Per-item phase status lives solely in the exit checklists</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-024</td> <td>Adapters receive a <code>RunContext</code>, not piecemeal parameters</td> <td>accepted; device-list review opened</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-072</td> <td>Standing self-merge-with-full-gate authority (gh merges included)</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td><a href="decision_log_archive_1.html#d-073">D-073</a></td> <td>D-016 device-list amendment: Mac + 3080 Ti primary fleet, 12 GiB cap</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td><a href="decision_log_archive_1.html#d-074">D-074</a></td> <td>Conditional Qwen3-4B primary repin + OLMo-1B conversion spike authorized</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td><a href="decision_log_archive_1.html#d-075">D-075</a></td> <td>Extension-axis intake: ranked fold-in without new thesis proliferation</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td><a href="decision_log_archive_1.html#d-076">D-076</a></td> <td>Site capacity right-sizing (AUD-WO-039 review): measured-first budgets</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td><a href="decision_log_archive_1.html#d-077">D-077</a></td> <td>Environment guard, idle admission, and cooldown v2</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td><a href="decision_log.html#d-078">D-078</a></td> <td>Soundness gate: no claim-bearing extraction from time-anchor-defective powermetrics corpora</td> <td>accepted; operative under Ed&#39;s direction through the full repair arc (close-out cap explicitly Ed-ratified 2026-07-22; original-text ratification rides PR #79 review)</td> </tr> </tbody></table></div> <hr> <blockquote> <p><strong>Site view:</strong> the complete entry index appears above; the 72 older full entries are omitted from this page for capsule size. The complete log is the repository file <a href="https://github.com/mpmdw/JouleWise/blob/main/docs/decision_log.md"><code>docs/decision_log.md</code></a>.</p> </blockquote> <span id="d-073"></span><h2 id="d-073-d-016-device-list-amendment-mac-3080-ti-primary-fleet-12-gib-cap">D-073: D-016 device-list amendment — Mac + 3080 Ti primary fleet, 12 GiB cap</h2> <p>Date: 2026-07-16. Owner: Ed (ruled on the D-071 brief, <code>docs/process_traces/2026-07-16-device-list-brief/brief.md</code>). The primary cross-target fleet is the 128 GB M3 Max Mac and the 3080 Ti (12 GiB) rig; the G10 capacity cap re-floors from 8 GiB to <strong>12 GiB</strong> (3080 Ti class sets the floor). Jetson hardware is retained as OPTIONAL, non-cap-setting replication — the edge/8 GiB cell can be added later as a replication row without re-deciding this. The split study&#39;s two nodes are the Mac and the 3080 Ti rig. Big models remain open via the Mac-only subsystem (D-071 clause 3). Follow-ons ruled by Ed same session: (a) conditional primary-model repin remains open with a WIDENED candidate search under the new cap (Ed: &quot;is there really nothing better than Qwen3-1.7B? Gemma 4B or something?&quot;) — 3-4B-class models now fit comfortably; (b) dense/MoE pair re-search under the 12 GiB cap (OLMo dense arm failed G4 as published — see the OLMo verification record in the same trace directory).</p> <span id="d-074"></span><h2 id="d-074-conditional-qwen3-4b-primary-repin-olmo-1b-conversion-spike-authorized">D-074: Conditional Qwen3-4B primary repin + OLMo-1B conversion spike authorized</h2> <p>Date: 2026-07-16. Owner: Ed (ruled on the 12 GiB model search, <code>docs/process_traces/2026-07-16-device-list-brief/model-search-12gib.md</code>). (1) Qwen3-4B becomes the D-016 primary CONDITIONALLY: the repin lands only when the evidence gates pass (immutable source/license, MLX-Q4/GGUF-Q4/CUDA artifact receipts, three-runtime generation, G10 at the 12 GiB cap, KV receipts, thinking-mode policy pinned); any gate failure retains Qwen2.5-1.5B. New evidence era on success: manifests + quant ladder regenerate from one frozen source revision; Qwen2.5 results preserved as legacy. Runner-up Qwen3-1.7B; Gemma-3-4B rejected for the gated custom license + multimodal MLX seam. (2) The time-boxed OLMo-1B original-format→MLX conversion spike is authorized; success revives the matched OLMoE pair, failure files the dated negative finding and the pair defers (Option C) without re-litigation. Both execute next session as agent-lane work.</p> <span id="d-075"></span><h2 id="d-075-extension-axis-intake-ranked-fold-in-without-new-thesis-proliferation">D-075: Extension-axis intake — ranked fold-in without new thesis proliferation</h2> <ul> <li>Date: 2026-07-17</li> <li>Status: accepted (Ed-directed intake via the 2026-07-17 evaluation)</li> <li>Phase: Phase 2+ research program</li> </ul> <p>Context: Ed directed a six-axis evaluation and ratified the resulting roadmap at <code>docs/process_traces/2026-07-17-extension-axes/roadmap-synthesis.md</code>. D-055 keeps C5 deliberation in the bank and the registry as the canonical live index; D-070 keeps these axes as stress tests of Q4, caps candidate commitments at L2, and reserves commitment authority to Ed. The disposition ledger is <code>docs/stream_logs/2026-07-17-axes-foldin.md</code>.</p> <p>Decision:</p> <ol> <li>Admit C5-2.5c as the primary speculative-decoding Q4 break-even rider, C5-2.5b as its proposal-work secondary, and C5-2.5d as a mandatory contamination control. Preserve C5-2.5a in the deliberative bank as a deferred candidate rider only; it is not a standalone campaign commitment before a prospective cross-mechanism design is affordable. All four retain the evaluation&#39;s exact ceilings and forbidden upgrades, and C-023-OUTPUT-IDENTITY is binding.</li> <li>Admit C5-2.11 as the on-device MLX quantized-KV candidate and attach it to C5-2.4, C5-1.12, and C-023-QUALITY-EQUIV-QUANT. Preserve C5-2.12, C5-2.13, and C5-2.14 only as candidate riders on the existing context/KV-growth, prompt-cache/replay, and Q4/AP-1 homes.</li> <li>Admit one new canonical RQ row, RQ-AXI-HYBRID-PAIR, at an L2 named-pair ceiling. Attach the attention/context-slope and module-attribution refinements to existing rows. Record kernel/backend provenance as amendments to C5-1.8, C5-2.7, and C5-3.3, not new theses.</li> <li>Keep the roadmap&#39;s do-not-fold set out of the canonical row set. Its negative dispositions and all unresolved feasibility questions remain in the stream ledger, including explicit <strong>NEEDS-WEB</strong> markers. Intake does not convert an unresolved runtime, model-pair, adapter, or device-fit question into a capstone commitment.</li> </ol> <p>Options considered:</p> <ol> <li>Mint every evaluated suggestion as an independent live question. Rejected: it duplicates existing homes, imports unidentifiable mechanism claims, and violates D-070&#39;s single-Q4-thesis posture.</li> <li>Admit only the top three ranked items. Rejected: the lower-cost controls, riders, and provenance amendments prevent predictable attribution errors without creating independent theses.</li> <li>Apply the roadmap&#39;s ranked fold-in and explicit exclusions. Chosen by Ed.</li> </ol> <p>Considerations: this is research-agenda intake, not campaign scheduling or evidence promotion. Every admitted candidate/rider remains floor-gated, earliest-phase tagged, capped at L2 unless an already-existing parent row&#39;s separate machinery says otherwise, and subject to its named forbidden upgrade. The published corpus remains claim-evidence-flagged; no fixture, runtime feasibility result, or registry entry is live energy evidence. D-070 remains the authority for Ed&#39;s axis commitments and quiet-Mac ordering.</p> <p>Revisit triggers: a relevant <strong>NEEDS-WEB</strong> feasibility finding lands; a named runtime/pair becomes unsupported; P2-015 floors make a predeclared effect undetectable; or Ed changes the D-070 commitment set. Revisit by amending the owning row and this decision&#39;s ledger, never by silently promoting an excluded candidate.</p> <span id="d-076"></span><h2 id="d-076-site-capacity-right-sizing-aud-wo-039-review-measured-first-budgets">D-076: Site capacity right-sizing (AUD-WO-039 review) — measured-first budgets</h2> <p>Date: 2026-07-17/18. Owner: lead under Ed&#39;s &quot;host the brief&quot; directive (the capacity decision event AUD-WO-039 fenced on). Ruling, encoded in tests with PR #76: the 1 MiB Lakebed hard cap is inviolate; the measured-artifact budget is 1,000,000 B (measured mode via the pinned validator, SITE-02 loud-discovery discipline); the 943,718 B conservative-estimate guard remains ONLY as fallback when measured mode is unavailable (estimator overshoot documented ~4.3% on identical input). WO-039 preservation boundary held: no advisor-facing page, navigation, provenance, or deep link trimmed. Current measured artifact 961,210 B. Revisit trigger: measured artifact within 24 KB of the hard cap forces the next right-sizing review before any addition.</p> <span id="d-077"></span><h2 id="d-077-environment-guard-idle-admission-and-cooldown-v2">D-077: Environment guard, idle admission, and cooldown v2</h2> <ul> <li>Date: 2026-07-17</li> <li>Status: accepted</li> <li>Phase: 2 / measurement</li> </ul> <p>Context: a Ventura video screensaver compositing on an awake display was identified as a material, repeatable contaminant. The affected windows showed about 50% GPU duty and were already detected by the existing <code>idle_window_suspect</code> thresholds. The campaign preflight, per-run admission, and D-014 cooldown nevertheless lacked one shared environment policy, exact override custody, and a sustained-window implementation. In particular, the old cooldown could release after one 5-second sub-window even though the contract called for a rolling 30-second recovery window.</p> <p>Options considered:</p> <ol> <li>Treat doctor output as a quietness certificate and continue to rely on operator judgment between members. Rejected: a point-in-time advisory cannot certify the later measured window and cannot enforce fixed-n admission.</li> <li>Change persistent display/screensaver preferences or allow contaminated members to be skipped or waived. Rejected: campaign preparation must not mutate host policy, and outcome-dependent skipping/waiving would break the fixed-n design and conceal the contamination.</li> <li>Use a hash-bound campaign-policy sidecar, an enforcing campaign preflight, per-run idle admission with one evidence-bearing retry, and cooldown v2 with frozen clean-anchor fallback. Chosen.</li> </ol> <p>Decision:</p> <ul> <li>A shared pure evaluator owns environment findings. Doctor consumes it only advisorily. <code>run_campaign.py</code> consumes it enforcingly after taking the campaign lock and before member 1. Critical unknowns fail closed. Load average is recorded as evidence but is never a member-admission gate.</li> <li>The production quiet-Mac policy requires AC power with an externally connected source, low-power mode off, all online displays asleep, the screensaver disengaged, and Nominal thermal pressure. Quiet-mode arming is explicit and transient: countdown, <code>pmset displaysleepnow</code>, then a complete re-probe. Persistent settings are never changed.</li> <li>An environment override must name the exact snapshot and findings digests it acknowledges. It is recorded as an override, never a waiver, and makes every resulting member universally claim-ineligible.</li> <li>Per-run idle admission reuses the validated <code>idle_window_suspect == false</code> threshold. It permits exactly one fully evidenced retry with distinct raw artifacts. Persistent awake-display, screensaver, or unknown critical state aborts immediately. Production aborts after retry; the exploratory-only <code>flag</code> path completes the fixed-n member but stamps the unwaivable <code>environment_admission_failed</code> reason on gross-energy, idle-subtracted-energy, and throughput claims. There is no skip action.</li> <li>Cooldown v2 amends D-014: recovery requires a complete, duration-weighted, sustained 30-second evidence window; the one-sided rule is <code>rolling_mean &lt;= reference * (1 + tolerance)</code>, so a below-reference window is recovered. Nominal thermal state is conjunctive. A calibrated absolute ceiling, when configured, is only an additional upper cap. A preceding baseline is reference-eligible only when its idle window is clean, critical environment checks passed, and policy/environment provenance is present. Otherwise the campaign uses one frozen clean anchor (NEG-8 reference start when present, else the first admission-passing baseline), records its provenance, never updates it from later outcomes, and fails closed when no eligible reference or anchor exists. Historical recovered rows are not reinterpreted.</li> <li>The policy owner is a strictly typed, byte-hashed sidecar under <code>configs/campaign_policies/</code>; policy version and SHA-256 are copied into each governed bundle. Campaign execution defaults to the production sidecar. Direct <code>joulewise run</code> without a sidecar retains legacy non-enforcing behavior. All bundle/config additions are nullable or omission-serialized; legacy normalized config bytes and hashes are unchanged.</li> <li>This amends D-057&#39;s stable claim-reason vocabulary by adding <code>environment_admission_failed</code> and <code>environment_override</code>. Both are universal and unwaivable for gross-energy, idle-subtracted-energy, and throughput claims.</li> </ul> <p>Considerations: environment admission is measurement-apparatus integrity, not post-hoc data cleaning. Duration weighting prevents irregular sub-window cadence from manufacturing coverage. Frozen-anchor provenance prevents a contaminated or outcome-selected member from quietly becoming the campaign&#39;s new recovery reference. The doctor remains useful as an early advisor without claiming more than its snapshot can prove.</p> <p>Consequences: campaign and bundle contracts gain policy/preflight/admission provenance, environment snapshots gain nullable display/screensaver/HID fields plus a post-run observation, and D-014&#39;s recovery wording is governed by cooldown v2 for new evidence. This decision is separate from AUD-WO-033, which remains behavior-preserving; D-077 intentionally changes future measurement admission and cooldown behavior and does not reinterpret sealed historical bundles.</p> <p>Revisit when: live quiet-window validation contradicts the defensive <code>pmset -g systemstate</code> display parser; calibrated platform data justifies an absolute ceiling; or a new platform cannot expose an equivalent critical probe without privilege.</p> <p>Fix-round amendment (2026-07-18): review found that summing sub-window durations as the completeness test made small inter-probe gaps reject an otherwise complete wall-clock window. Cooldown v2 now requires both a retained wall-clock span of at least <code>sustained_window_s</code> and captured coverage of at least <code>coverage_fraction * sustained_window_s</code>, with <code>coverage_fraction</code> defaulting to 0.8 and recorded in thresholds, trace rows, and release evidence. The same fix round made the existing frozen-reference rule operational for controller repetitions, attached cooldown evidence to each physical repetition (and each AXI entry), froze the first eligible repetition in execution order, re-probed the full governed environment per repetition, and added a guard observation after every idle capture. Environment-preflight early exits now retain a terminal campaign verdict; missing screensaver defaults domains use the macOS 20-minute default; and the two D-077 claim barriers are registered in the canonical reducer vocabulary. These are defect corrections to the accepted policy, not new policy alternatives.</p> <nav class="doc-meta" aria-label="Decision log parts"><span>Decision log parts:</span> <a href="decision_log.html">Recent</a> · <strong aria-current="page">Archive 1</strong></nav> </div> </div> </main> <footer class="site"> <div class="inner"> <span>JouleWise · github.com/mpmdw/JouleWise</span> <span>docs/decision_log.md · commit 1af9f92 + uncommitted · regenerate: <span class="mono">python3 scripts/build_site.py</span></span> </div> </footer> </body> </html>

Log</h1> <p>This is the canonical record of design decisions for JouleWise. Every decision that binds later work, trades off real alternatives, or would otherwise need to be re-derived by a future agent gets an entry here.</p> <h2 id="how-to-use-this-log">How To Use This Log</h2> <ul> <li>Before implementing anything non-trivial, check whether a decision here already covers it. Do not silently re-decide settled questions.</li> <li>When you make a new decision of this kind during a run, add an entry, link it from the run report, and reference its ID (<code>D-NNN</code>) in the code review or doc that applies it.</li> <li>Statuses: <code>accepted</code> (binding until revisited), <code>open</code> (criteria defined, evidence pending), <code>proposed</code> (recorded, awaiting Ed&#39;s ratification), <code>superseded by D-NNN</code>.</li> <li>Every entry must include Options Considered and Considerations. A decision without recorded alternatives is not auditable.</li> <li>Revisit triggers are part of the contract: when a trigger fires, the decision must be re-examined, not quietly worked around.</li> </ul> <h2 id="index">Index</h2> <div class="table-scroll"><table> <thead> <tr> <th>ID</th> <th>Title</th> <th>Status</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody><tr> <td>D-001</td> <td>Run bundles store normalized <code>config.json</code>, not YAML</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-002</td> <td>Telemetry sampling via subprocess + file, no controller threading</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-003</td> <td>Timestamp and clock-alignment policy</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-004</td> <td><code>powermetrics</code> privilege workflow</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-005</td> <td>One bundle per repetition, grouped by experiment manifest</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-006</td> <td>Dashboard v1 is a static HTML report generator</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-007</td> <td>YAML config input is deferred</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-008</td> <td>Split runs arrive via schema v0.2 (<code>run_kind</code> + <code>split_plan</code>)</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-009</td> <td>Dependency policy: stdlib core, optional extras</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-010</td> <td>Run ID scheme</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-011</td> <td><code>summary_metrics.json</code> is the bundle completion marker</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-012</td> <td>Failure-reason to run-status mapping</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-013</td> <td>Controller-as-DUT mitigation for Mac-local runs</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-014</td> <td>Statistical protocol for repeated runs</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-015</td> <td>Split-mechanism priority and same-runtime rule</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-016</td> <td>Benchmark model selection</td> <td>open (provisional small-model pick 2026-07-06; device-list review opened</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td>D-072</td> <td>Standing self-merge-with-full-gate authority (gh merges included)</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td><a href="decision_log_archive_1.html#d-073">D-073</a></td> <td>D-016 device-list amendment: Mac + 3080 Ti primary fleet, 12 GiB cap</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td><a href="decision_log_archive_1.html#d-074">D-074</a></td> <td>Conditional Qwen3-4B primary repin + OLMo-1B conversion spike authorized</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td><a href="decision_log_archive_1.html#d-075">D-075</a></td> <td>Extension-axis intake: ranked fold-in without new thesis proliferation</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td><a href="decision_log_archive_1.html#d-076">D-076</a></td> <td>Site capacity right-sizing (AUD-WO-039 review): measured-first budgets</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td><a href="decision_log_archive_1.html#d-077">D-077</a></td> <td>Environment guard, idle admission, and cooldown v2</td> <td>accepted</td> </tr> <tr> <td><a href="decision_log.html#d-078">D-078</a></td> <td>Soundness gate: no claim-bearing extraction from time-anchor-defective powermetrics corpora</td> <td>accepted; operative under Ed&#39;s direction through the full repair arc (close-out cap explicitly Ed-ratified 2026-07-22; original-text ratification rides PR #79 review)</td> </tr> </tbody></table></div> <hr> <blockquote> <p><strong>Site view:</strong> the complete entry index appears above; the 72 older full entries are omitted from this page for capsule size. The complete log is the repository file <a href="https://github.com/mpmdw/JouleWise/blob/main/docs/decision_log.md"><code>docs/decision_log.md</code></a>.</p> </blockquote> <span id="d-073"></span><h2 id="d-073-d-016-device-list-amendment-mac-3080-ti-primary-fleet-12-gib-cap">D-073: D-016 device-list amendment — Mac + 3080 Ti primary fleet, 12 GiB cap</h2> <p>Date: 2026-07-16. Owner: Ed (ruled on the D-071 brief, <code>docs/process_traces/2026-07-16-device-list-brief/brief.md</code>). The primary cross-target fleet is the 128 GB M3 Max Mac and the 3080 Ti (12 GiB) rig; the G10 capacity cap re-floors from 8 GiB to <strong>12 GiB</strong> (3080 Ti class sets the floor). Jetson hardware is retained as OPTIONAL, non-cap-setting replication — the edge/8 GiB cell can be added later as a replication row without re-deciding this. The split study&#39;s two nodes are the Mac and the 3080 Ti rig. Big models remain open via the Mac-only subsystem (D-071 clause 3). Follow-ons ruled by Ed same session: (a) conditional primary-model repin remains open with a WIDENED candidate search under the new cap (Ed: &quot;is there really nothing better than Qwen3-1.7B? Gemma 4B or something?&quot;) — 3-4B-class models now fit comfortably; (b) dense/MoE pair re-search under the 12 GiB cap (OLMo dense arm failed G4 as published — see the OLMo verification record in the same trace directory).</p> <span id="d-074"></span><h2 id="d-074-conditional-qwen3-4b-primary-repin-olmo-1b-conversion-spike-authorized">D-074: Conditional Qwen3-4B primary repin + OLMo-1B conversion spike authorized</h2> <p>Date: 2026-07-16. Owner: Ed (ruled on the 12 GiB model search, <code>docs/process_traces/2026-07-16-device-list-brief/model-search-12gib.md</code>). (1) Qwen3-4B becomes the D-016 primary CONDITIONALLY: the repin lands only when the evidence gates pass (immutable source/license, MLX-Q4/GGUF-Q4/CUDA artifact receipts, three-runtime generation, G10 at the 12 GiB cap, KV receipts, thinking-mode policy pinned); any gate failure retains Qwen2.5-1.5B. New evidence era on success: manifests + quant ladder regenerate from one frozen source revision; Qwen2.5 results preserved as legacy. Runner-up Qwen3-1.7B; Gemma-3-4B rejected for the gated custom license + multimodal MLX seam. (2) The time-boxed OLMo-1B original-format→MLX conversion spike is authorized; success revives the matched OLMoE pair, failure files the dated negative finding and the pair defers (Option C) without re-litigation. Both execute next session as agent-lane work.</p> <span id="d-075"></span><h2 id="d-075-extension-axis-intake-ranked-fold-in-without-new-thesis-proliferation">D-075: Extension-axis intake — ranked fold-in without new thesis proliferation</h2> <ul> <li>Date: 2026-07-17</li> <li>Status: accepted (Ed-directed intake via the 2026-07-17 evaluation)</li> <li>Phase: Phase 2+ research program</li> </ul> <p>Context: Ed directed a six-axis evaluation and ratified the resulting roadmap at <code>docs/process_traces/2026-07-17-extension-axes/roadmap-synthesis.md</code>. D-055 keeps C5 deliberation in the bank and the registry as the canonical live index; D-070 keeps these axes as stress tests of Q4, caps candidate commitments at L2, and reserves commitment authority to Ed. The disposition ledger is <code>docs/stream_logs/2026-07-17-axes-foldin.md</code>.</p> <p>Decision:</p> <ol> <li>Admit C5-2.5c as the primary speculative-decoding Q4 break-even rider, C5-2.5b as its proposal-work secondary, and C5-2.5d as a mandatory contamination control. Preserve C5-2.5a in the deliberative bank as a deferred candidate rider only; it is not a standalone campaign commitment before a prospective cross-mechanism design is affordable. All four retain the evaluation&#39;s exact ceilings and forbidden upgrades, and C-023-OUTPUT-IDENTITY is binding.</li> <li>Admit C5-2.11 as the on-device MLX quantized-KV candidate and attach it to C5-2.4, C5-1.12, and C-023-QUALITY-EQUIV-QUANT. Preserve C5-2.12, C5-2.13, and C5-2.14 only as candidate riders on the existing context/KV-growth, prompt-cache/replay, and Q4/AP-1 homes.</li> <li>Admit one new canonical RQ row, RQ-AXI-HYBRID-PAIR, at an L2 named-pair ceiling. Attach the attention/context-slope and module-attribution refinements to existing rows. Record kernel/backend provenance as amendments to C5-1.8, C5-2.7, and C5-3.3, not new theses.</li> <li>Keep the roadmap&#39;s do-not-fold set out of the canonical row set. Its negative dispositions and all unresolved feasibility questions remain in the stream ledger, including explicit <strong>NEEDS-WEB</strong> markers. Intake does not convert an unresolved runtime, model-pair, adapter, or device-fit question into a capstone commitment.</li> </ol> <p>Options considered:</p> <ol> <li>Mint every evaluated suggestion as an independent live question. Rejected: it duplicates existing homes, imports unidentifiable mechanism claims, and violates D-070&#39;s single-Q4-thesis posture.</li> <li>Admit only the top three ranked items. Rejected: the lower-cost controls, riders, and provenance amendments prevent predictable attribution errors without creating independent theses.</li> <li>Apply the roadmap&#39;s ranked fold-in and explicit exclusions. Chosen by Ed.</li> </ol> <p>Considerations: this is research-agenda intake, not campaign scheduling or evidence promotion. Every admitted candidate/rider remains floor-gated, earliest-phase tagged, capped at L2 unless an already-existing parent row&#39;s separate machinery says otherwise, and subject to its named forbidden upgrade. The published corpus remains claim-evidence-flagged; no fixture, runtime feasibility result, or registry entry is live energy evidence. D-070 remains the authority for Ed&#39;s axis commitments and quiet-Mac ordering.</p> <p>Revisit triggers: a relevant <strong>NEEDS-WEB</strong> feasibility finding lands; a named runtime/pair becomes unsupported; P2-015 floors make a predeclared effect undetectable; or Ed changes the D-070 commitment set. Revisit by amending the owning row and this decision&#39;s ledger, never by silently promoting an excluded candidate.</p> <span id="d-076"></span><h2 id="d-076-site-capacity-right-sizing-aud-wo-039-review-measured-first-budgets">D-076: Site capacity right-sizing (AUD-WO-039 review) — measured-first budgets</h2> <p>Date: 2026-07-17/18. Owner: lead under Ed&#39;s &quot;host the brief&quot; directive (the capacity decision event AUD-WO-039 fenced on). Ruling, encoded in tests with PR #76: the 1 MiB Lakebed hard cap is inviolate; the measured-artifact budget is 1,000,000 B (measured mode via the pinned validator, SITE-02 loud-discovery discipline); the 943,718 B conservative-estimate guard remains ONLY as fallback when measured mode is unavailable (estimator overshoot documented ~4.3% on identical input). WO-039 preservation boundary held: no advisor-facing page, navigation, provenance, or deep link trimmed. Current measured artifact 961,210 B. Revisit trigger: measured artifact within 24 KB of the hard cap forces the next right-sizing review before any addition.</p> <span id="d-077"></span><h2 id="d-077-environment-guard-idle-admission-and-cooldown-v2">D-077: Environment guard, idle admission, and cooldown v2</h2> <ul> <li>Date: 2026-07-17</li> <li>Status: accepted</li> <li>Phase: 2 / measurement</li> </ul> <p>Context: a Ventura video screensaver compositing on an awake display was identified as a material, repeatable contaminant. The affected windows showed about 50% GPU duty and were already detected by the existing <code>idle_window_suspect</code> thresholds. The campaign preflight, per-run admission, and D-014 cooldown nevertheless lacked one shared environment policy, exact override custody, and a sustained-window implementation. In particular, the old cooldown could release after one 5-second sub-window even though the contract called for a rolling 30-second recovery window.</p> <p>Options considered:</p> <ol> <li>Treat doctor output as a quietness certificate and continue to rely on operator judgment between members. Rejected: a point-in-time advisory cannot certify the later measured window and cannot enforce fixed-n admission.</li> <li>Change persistent display/screensaver preferences or allow contaminated members to be skipped or waived. Rejected: campaign preparation must not mutate host policy, and outcome-dependent skipping/waiving would break the fixed-n design and conceal the contamination.</li> <li>Use a hash-bound campaign-policy sidecar, an enforcing campaign preflight, per-run idle admission with one evidence-bearing retry, and cooldown v2 with frozen clean-anchor fallback. Chosen.</li> </ol> <p>Decision:</p> <ul> <li>A shared pure evaluator owns environment findings. Doctor consumes it only advisorily. <code>run_campaign.py</code> consumes it enforcingly after taking the campaign lock and before member 1. Critical unknowns fail closed. Load average is recorded as evidence but is never a member-admission gate.</li> <li>The production quiet-Mac policy requires AC power with an externally connected source, low-power mode off, all online displays asleep, the screensaver disengaged, and Nominal thermal pressure. Quiet-mode arming is explicit and transient: countdown, <code>pmset displaysleepnow</code>, then a complete re-probe. Persistent settings are never changed.</li> <li>An environment override must name the exact snapshot and findings digests it acknowledges. It is recorded as an override, never a waiver, and makes every resulting member universally claim-ineligible.</li> <li>Per-run idle admission reuses the validated <code>idle_window_suspect == false</code> threshold. It permits exactly one fully evidenced retry with distinct raw artifacts. Persistent awake-display, screensaver, or unknown critical state aborts immediately. Production aborts after retry; the exploratory-only <code>flag</code> path completes the fixed-n member but stamps the unwaivable <code>environment_admission_failed</code> reason on gross-energy, idle-subtracted-energy, and throughput claims. There is no skip action.</li> <li>Cooldown v2 amends D-014: recovery requires a complete, duration-weighted, sustained 30-second evidence window; the one-sided rule is <code>rolling_mean &lt;= reference * (1 + tolerance)</code>, so a below-reference window is recovered. Nominal thermal state is conjunctive. A calibrated absolute ceiling, when configured, is only an additional upper cap. A preceding baseline is reference-eligible only when its idle window is clean, critical environment checks passed, and policy/environment provenance is present. Otherwise the campaign uses one frozen clean anchor (NEG-8 reference start when present, else the first admission-passing baseline), records its provenance, never updates it from later outcomes, and fails closed when no eligible reference or anchor exists. Historical recovered rows are not reinterpreted.</li> <li>The policy owner is a strictly typed, byte-hashed sidecar under <code>configs/campaign_policies/</code>; policy version and SHA-256 are copied into each governed bundle. Campaign execution defaults to the production sidecar. Direct <code>joulewise run</code> without a sidecar retains legacy non-enforcing behavior. All bundle/config additions are nullable or omission-serialized; legacy normalized config bytes and hashes are unchanged.</li> <li>This amends D-057&#39;s stable claim-reason vocabulary by adding <code>environment_admission_failed</code> and <code>environment_override</code>. Both are universal and unwaivable for gross-energy, idle-subtracted-energy, and throughput claims.</li> </ul> <p>Considerations: environment admission is measurement-apparatus integrity, not post-hoc data cleaning. Duration weighting prevents irregular sub-window cadence from manufacturing coverage. Frozen-anchor provenance prevents a contaminated or outcome-selected member from quietly becoming the campaign&#39;s new recovery reference. The doctor remains useful as an early advisor without claiming more than its snapshot can prove.</p> <p>Consequences: campaign and bundle contracts gain policy/preflight/admission provenance, environment snapshots gain nullable display/screensaver/HID fields plus a post-run observation, and D-014&#39;s recovery wording is governed by cooldown v2 for new evidence. This decision is separate from AUD-WO-033, which remains behavior-preserving; D-077 intentionally changes future measurement admission and cooldown behavior and does not reinterpret sealed historical bundles.</p> <p>Revisit when: live quiet-window validation contradicts the defensive <code>pmset -g systemstate</code> display parser; calibrated platform data justifies an absolute ceiling; or a new platform cannot expose an equivalent critical probe without privilege.</p> <p>Fix-round amendment (2026-07-18): review found that summing sub-window durations as the completeness test made small inter-probe gaps reject an otherwise complete wall-clock window. Cooldown v2 now requires both a retained wall-clock span of at least <code>sustained_window_s</code> and captured coverage of at least <code>coverage_fraction * sustained_window_s</code>, with <code>coverage_fraction</code> defaulting to 0.8 and recorded in thresholds, trace rows, and release evidence. The same fix round made the existing frozen-reference rule operational for controller repetitions, attached cooldown evidence to each physical repetition (and each AXI entry), froze the first eligible repetition in execution order, re-probed the full governed environment per repetition, and added a guard observation after every idle capture. Environment-preflight early exits now retain a terminal campaign verdict; missing screensaver defaults domains use the macOS 20-minute default; and the two D-077 claim barriers are registered in the canonical reducer vocabulary. These are defect corrections to the accepted policy, not new policy alternatives.</p> <nav class="doc-meta" aria-label="Decision log parts"><span>Decision log parts:</span> <a href="decision_log.html">Recent</a> · <strong aria-current="page">Archive 1</strong></nav> </div> </div> </main> <footer class="site"> <div class="inner"> <span>JouleWise · github.com/mpmdw/JouleWise</span> <span>docs/decision_log.md · commit 1af9f92 + uncommitted · regenerate: <span class="mono">python3 scripts/build_site.py</span></span> </div> </footer> </body> </html>
